name: prototype
description: Prototype / visual-decision skill for spec authoring. Generates throwaway UI variants (default 3, max 5, MIN 2 valid else NEEDS_CONTEXT) to resolve layout / density / motion questions that text-only specs cannot answer. Brownfield uses ?variant=A|B|C|E + floating switcher; greenfield generates static HTML at .omo/prototypes/<plan>/. Records [proto] decisions in decisions.md and replaces [PROTO-RESOLVE] markers in the spec. NOT for production UI, deploy, or design-token handoff.

positive_triggers.input: The spec has [PROTO-RESOLVE: should the dashboard use bento grid or sidebar navigation?] and we need to pick a layout before spec_approved. Show me three prototype variants for visual fidelity.
positive_triggers.reason: Explicit [PROTO-RESOLVE] marker + visual fidelity + prototype variant request matches Phase 1.2 visual gating

positive_triggers.input: I am spec authoring the marketing landing page and need to compare layout / density / motion alternatives before locking the spec. Generate three throwaway prototype variants A/B/C.
positive_triggers.reason: Spec authoring context with explicit prototype variant generation request

positive_triggers.input: Run /prototype for the on-checkout-flow feature so I can visually pick between compact and spacious density on the brownfield checkout route.
positive_triggers.reason: Direct /prototype invocation in brownfield context with switcher requirement

negative_triggers.input: Implement the production dashboard with the chosen bento grid layout. Use meisijiya-frontend-taste rules and ship it.
negative_triggers.reason: Implement production feature is incremental-implementation territory, not throwaway prototype scaffolding

negative_triggers.input: Deploy the chosen variant to production and run pre-ship-gate before rolling out the canary.
negative_triggers.reason: Deploy / rollout is pre-ship-gate / closed-loop-delivery territory, not prototype

negative_triggers.input: Generate design tokens and a UI/UX spec so the designer can build the marketing page in Figma.
negative_triggers.reason: Ship / design-token handoff is designer-handoff + meisijiya-frontend-taste, not prototype throwaway scaffolds

behavioral_evals.scenario: Brownfield behavioral: existing route at .opencode/plugins/meisijiya-skills.js must accept ?variant=A|B|C|E and serve three prototype variants with a floating switcher; status.json transitions to awaiting_selection with at least 2 valid variants.
expected_behavior: Agent reads the existing route and writes throwaway scaffold under .omo/throwaway-worktree/<feature>/
Agent generates 3 prototype variants differing on at least one axis (layout / density / motion)
Agent creates floating bottom-bar switcher for live variant comparison
Agent initializes .omo/prototypes/<plan>/status.json with state=awaiting_selection and variants[] array listing 3 entries with render:ok
Agent pauses for explicit user selection; does not auto-resolve

behavioral_evals.scenario: Greenfield behavioral: plan slug qa-proto-demo with no existing route; agent generates static HTML prototypes at .omo/prototypes/qa-proto-demo/{variant-A,B,C,index}.html with status=awaiting_selection.
expected_behavior: Agent writes three variant HTML files + index.html listing all variants
Agent does NOT delegate to build-gate-visual-review (its <script> ban is incompatible with the switcher)
Agent initializes status.json with state=awaiting_selection and 3 valid variants
After QA, agent tears down .omo/prototypes/qa-proto-demo/ and the status.json

notes: v0.1.0 — initial TODO 3 slice. Three positive triggers cover [PROTO-RESOLVE] marker, spec authoring context, and direct /prototype invocation. Three negative triggers cover production implementation, deployment, and design-token handoff. Two behavioral scenarios cover brownfield (existing route) and greenfield (own HTML generator) paths. Status state machine: triggered -> generating -> awaiting_selection -> resolved (alt: need_context, bypassed). [proto] decisions.md format documented in SKILL.md Process §6.
